paragraphs: A purpose-built AI receptionist system engineered for small and independent US heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) contractors.

AERIS AI Receptionist is an automated, 24/7 receptionist product that answers inbound customer calls, understands reported HVAC issues, collects verified customer details, qualifies leads, schedules inspection windows, and routes or escalates requests appropriately. Under the hood, AERIS AI leverages Google's Gemini API (Gemini 3.8 Live for native bi-directional voice and Gemini 3.8 Flash for text chat and extraction). It operates under strict non-diagnosis and non-hallucination policies: it never fabricates prices or warranties, never provides hazardous technical repair advice, and…

Operational Boundary & Non-Diagnosis Policy: The AI receptionist is strictly designed for customer service intake, lead capture, and routing for certified HVAC contractors. It does NOT perform professional HVAC diagnosis, repair decisions, safety determinations, or technical instructions. All pricing, availability, and policies are strictly dictated by contractor configuration.
